name: code-editor-workspace
title: Code Editor Workspace
description: A developer code workspace featuring numbered lines, language selection, run action, and simulated execution console.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Code Editing And Terminal Output: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
